title: Pharaohs: Rise & Fall
description: A powerful military leader unites the lands we know as Egypt and assumes the title of Pharaoh; exploring how he maintains this position of power; what tools does he use to build a system that will last 3,000 years?

title: I Died... And Came Back
description: A man accidentally overdoses on a toxic substance and dies in a fast food restaurant bathroom; then a drug-fueled party at a bar ends with a young woman's near-death experience and final purpose of truth and discovery.

title: How I Got Here
description: Georgia's mother parted from her parents in Greece on bad terms at only sixteen years old; now, Georgia is desperate to connect with her Greek heritage and to have a better relationship with her own mother.

title: Nintendo 64 Quest
description: Jay and Rob travel to Indiana to meet up with an old friend in hopes of solving their newly discovered problem.

title: Castle Secrets
description: A sinister fortress; a place of blessing for Joan of Arc; a stronghold built of stone.

title: My Misdiagnosis
description: Kevin is a delivery driver for rural areas when he gets an itch that develops into anxiety, an accelerated heart rate and hypoglycemia; Carlyn is an active, young mother who gets breast augmentation surgery; soon after her health declines.

title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
description: Stars can burn for billions of years, but all will inevitably die; exploring why some gently dim but others explode; scientists study supernovae to unlock our cosmic history.

title: Fishing for History
description: Dreams of steam ships near Jefferson, Texas, lead Justin and Mike to discover a town swimming in history; from the American Civil War to murder mysteries and a paranormal presence that makes Jefferson the hot ticket for Bigfoot sightings in America.

title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
description: As planning for a northern expedition continues, the Farm Heim team starts testing the gear they will use in their bigger quest. Meanwhile, Jo, Johann, and David set out for Berens River, a place with potential clues of Lost Vikings.

title: Mapping Disaster
description: A journey through some of the most catastrophic events in human history, exploring disasters that can impact and change communities, and gaining new insight into how to design and construct communities to meet the dangers of the future.

description: Egypt is divided; local rulers called nomarchs vie for power, but only one will rise up to restore the kingdom and usher in a new era for the pharaohs; using literature, military might and conquest, the pharaoh and his forebears regain power.

description: From the Pantheon, to Mont Saint-Michel, and an enduring Roman gate that evolved into a medieval church, the exploration of history's most sacred spaces uncovers how ancient builders channeled faith and ingenuity into architectural marvels.

description: Johnny and Jordyn travel to Fall River, Massachusetts, to investigate the infamous Lizzie Borden House, the site of one of America's most notorious unsolved murder cases.

title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
description: Billions of years ago, the first sign of life emerged on Earth; how exactly did this miraculous event unfold? As we probe the past, astronomers turn their telescopes to exoplanets to uncover vital clues about our own origins on planet Earth.

title: Nazis: Threads of Evil
description: Adolf Eichmann, the meticulous bureaucrat behind the mass deportation of Jews, organizes genocide from behind a desk. After the war, he vanishes, only to be hunted down and tried decades later.
